The '''Ulgo Technical Works camp''' was a military staging camp atop the [[Frostrock Promontory]] in the [[Glarus Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was used by [[House Ulgo]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].
